info.name: Hospital Management System API
info.description:
Complete HMS API collection (all modules).

Base URL: http://localhost:8080

## Auth
- Sign In returns a session cookie (sent automatically on subsequent requests).
- Sign Out requires the Origin header for CSRF protection.
- Admin credentials (seeded): admin@hospital.com / Admin@123

## Roles
- SUPER_ADMIN / HOSPITAL_ADMIN: admin
- DOCTOR, NURSE, LAB_TECHNICIAN, PHARMACIST, ACCOUNTANT, RECEPTIONIST, PATHOLOGIST, BILLING_STAFF, INVENTORY_MANAGER, AMBULANCE_DISPATCHER, AMBULANCE_DRIVER, IT_SUPPORT: staff
- PATIENT: limited portal access

## Sequencing hints
Most endpoints are protected by role middleware. Start with Sign In, then run folder requests top-to-bottom. IDs like {{patientId}}, {{doctorId}}, {{departmentId}} etc. are placeholders — replace them with values returned by the create requests.

body.raw:
{
  "patientId": "{{patientId}}",
  "doctorId": "{{doctorId}}",
  "opdVisitId": "{{visitId}}",
  "diagnosisText": "Acute upper respiratory tract infection with fever",
  "symptoms": [
    "fever",
    "cough",
    "sore throat"
  ]
}
